svg.text: KA-RaceIng initial state – slice: hydrogen tank (DES) and hydrogen shutdown circuit (ELEC)
Rows are instances (name : Class) read from the persisted VSUM; arrows are all 37 stored correspondences between the shown instances (from left to right object).
EClass of UVL.ecore (as uvl2uvl stores it)
tag "" – feature ↔ realising element, domain root ↔ model root, feature ↔ configuration feature, UVL model ↔ configuration model / UVL_MODEL
tag "overlap" – semantically overlapping artefacts (interface constraint, scenario overlap, CAD part ↔ BOM item)
tag "requirement" – requirement ↔ artefact realising the feature the requirement is mapped to
grey italic: instance without any correspondence (group, value object; every artefact has a feature)
+n: further correspondences of this instance to instances not shown
… n more: further contained instances not shown
containment (inside one model) – arrows are correspondences (VSUM correspondence model, ● left object → right object)
